The problem we’re obsessed with

The world is about to put a price on numbers nobody can prove.

Every factory, every shipment and every supply chain is now being asked how much it emits, and money now changes hands based on the answer. Yet most of those numbers live in scanned bills, scattered spreadsheets and the memory of one tired person in an office. Nobody can trace them back to where they came from.

We think that’s one of the biggest unsolved data problems of this decade. We’re building the infrastructure to fix it: a system where every number that matters links to its source document, can be checked by anyone with the right access, and shows who touched it and when. We start with heavy industry in India. Over time, we want this to be the layer the world relies on when it needs to know whether a claim about the physical economy is real.

You’ll own the frontend of our core platform: the place where messy real-world documents become clean, trusted records.
